name: Bargarh–Vizianagaram Highway
aka: Formed from the former NH 201 and part of the former NH 43
history: NH 26 links the farming plains of western Odisha with the coastal belt of Andhra Pradesh. From Bargarh it runs south through Balangir, Bhawanipatna and the tribal districts of Nabarangpur and Koraput, then climbs over the Eastern Ghats to come down near Vizianagaram. It was created in the 2010 renumbering, mainly from the old NH 201 and the northern part of the old NH 43.
facts: About 555 km long, ending on NH 16, the Kolkata–Chennai coastal highway.
Crosses the Eastern Ghats between Koraput and Salur.
Official figures also count a stretch of the route in Chhattisgarh, between the Odisha sections.
Serves Koraput and Jeypore, gateway towns of Odisha's scenic tribal highlands.
